notes.title: Knights of Braveland is available now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40483356/4f9ee6c61bd6d6b93e22359b9e91571774277e99.png

Knights of Braveland is available now!

Heroes Guild awaits you. Only you can defeat all the infamous villains threatening the kingdom.

Knights of Braveland is a cooperative beat'em up action game with a generated story. Join the Heroes Guild and travel the path from a rookie to the hero of the kingdom. Head on a hunt for the vicious boss solo or with your friends. Your adventure will be randomly generated from hundreds of different events.

You will hack, slash, and smash your way to victory. And with your friends it is much more fun. Play local or online.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253610/Knights_of_Braveland/

Keep up with the latest news
We share updates on several different platforms. To hear about every tidbit as soon the info drops, you should join our other communities!

Discord - Twitter - Newsletter

notes.title: Наша новая игра Spaceland вышла!
notes.content:
Привет всем!

Сегодня мы хотели бы поделиться с вами грандиозной новостью: после 4 лет разработки выпущена наша новая сюжетная стратегия Spaceland!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7301975/2dbd72780049d4f61d67ab898351b945a33e669d.gif

Spaceland - это невероятно динамичная пошаговая стратегия, возрождающая традиции XCOM, Incubation и Laser Squad. Возглавьте команду из самых отчаянных бойцов, уничтожайте инопланетных монстров и раскройте секреты затерянной планеты.

[previewyoutube=myAlbM8H2uc;full][/previewyoutube]

Основные особенности:

 Игра основана на лучших пошаговых стратегиях старой школы - XCOM, Incubation, Laser Squad
 Невероятно динамичные пошаговые сражения продолжительностью 10-15 минут
 Составьте отряд из 7 космических рейнджеров, каждый со своим уникальным стилем боя
 История загадочной планеты в духе «золотого века» научной фантастики


Поддержите нашу новую игру с сюжетом в духе Braveland и начните космическое приключение!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1021070/Spaceland/

And remember - if you already own any of the titles above, buying the Pirate ‘AAAAR!’ bundle saves you money on the rest of those wonderful games!

notes.title: Update: improved spell system and new languages
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7301975/a6cff1ff53fc053fe8226b48b8bfb6c5c1615ae0.png

New Languages
7 new languages appeared - German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch and Simplified Chinese. Great work of translators. Hope it helps more people to become real Bravelanders.

Difficulty revamped
It's a little bit easier to play on easy and normal difficulties in the beginning. And you get more gold for battles. Hard difficulty has been revamped too.

Spell system improved
Now you gain more mana each turn. But your spells have overheat effect. In example, if you use Ice Arrow it will cost 7 mana instead of 5 next turn. So it makes more sense to use different spells in battle. And more spells more fun. Hope you like it.

notes.title: UPDATE: Grind issues fixed
notes.content:
No more grind
We've revamped all difficulties of Braveland Wizard and removed all grindy and repetitive battles. Now all dungeons give you more money, but they have limits and you can fight bandits only once per story battle. So you should use more strategy tricks to progress on hard difficulty.

6 new Languages!
We've added 6 new languages - German, French, Spanish, Italian Portuguese and Dutch. Hope it helps more people to become real Bravelanders. ;)

Fast battles
We've added fast battle mode that speeds up all animations. So you can play at your own pace. Hope you like it.

notes.title: Update: damage prediction and more
notes.content:
Hi, Bravelanders.

New improvements of Braveland Wizard arrived:

1. Video settings configuration is added for Windows version of the game. Choose your own screen resolution or even windowed mode.
2. Predicted damage is now shown in the Eye Mode on the battlefield.
3. Magic achievements fixed.
4. Minor UI improvements.

Tortuga Team.
